subject: pseudocode
question: What will be printed by the following pseudocode? (`&` is bitwise AND, `^` is bitwise XOR.)
code:
Integer p = 12, q = 10
Print (p & q) + (p ^ q)
explanation: 12 = 1100 and 10 = 1010 in binary. `p & q` = 1000 = 8 and `p ^ q` = 0110 = 6, so the result is 8 + 6 = 14. (In general, `(p & q) + (p ^ q)` equals `p | q`.)
